jurisdiction.name: Ontario, Canada

legislation.instrument: Mining Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. M.14 - Part VII Rehabilitation of Mining Lands
legislation.section: Part VII (closure plans; financial assurance; progressive rehabilitation; certified closure plans)
legislation.obligation: Filed and certified closure plan with financial assurance before advanced exploration or mine production; rehabilitation to the Code standard; changes by closure plan amendment
legislation.endState: Relinquishment route (surrender of lands after rehabilitation - verify the current mechanism); security release; completion criteria
legislation.confidence: High for the instrument; verify sections

legislation.instrument: O. Reg. 240/00 - Mine Development and Closure under Part VII of the Act (incl. the Mine Rehabilitation Code of Ontario, Schedule 1)
legislation.section: Closure plan content; Mine Rehabilitation Code (physical stability, chemical stability, revegetation, monitoring)
legislation.obligation: Prescribed closure plan contents and rehabilitation standards; monitoring requirements
legislation.confidence: High for the instrument; verify clauses

legislation.instrument: Ontario Water Resources Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. O.40
legislation.section: s. 53 Environmental Compliance Approval (sewage works, incl. mine effluent treatment and discharge)
legislation.obligation: ECA conditions on effluent quality, monitoring and reporting; amendment route for changes

legislation.instrument: Environmental Protection Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. E.19
legislation.section: s. 14 (discharge of a contaminant causing an adverse effect); orders
legislation.obligation: General prohibition and order-making powers that persist post-closure

legislation.instrument: Water Management: Policies, Guidelines, Provincial Water Quality Objectives (MOEE, 1994 'Blue Book') - Policy 2; Procedure B-1-5 (receiving-water based effluent requirements)
legislation.section: Policy 2 (two limbs: default non-degradation; modifying application through documented deviation on four grounds - Appendix C)
legislation.obligation: Receiving-water objectives; site-specific effluent requirements derived through B-1-5; the documented-deviation limb is Ontario's site-specific route
legislation.endState: Water; stacked-conservatism check (non-degradation default applied where the deviation route exists)
legislation.confidence: Medium - cite the Blue Book edition and B-1-5 directly

legislation.instrument: Fisheries Act, R.S.C. 1985, c. F-14, s. 36(3) and the Metal and Diamond Mining Effluent Regulations, SOR/2002-222
legislation.section: s. 36(3) deposit of deleterious substances; MDMER Schedule 4 (authorised limits; Table 2 for pre-2021 mines), Schedule 5 EEM
legislation.obligation: Federal effluent limits and environmental effects monitoring; selenium is an EEM fish-tissue trigger (5/10 ug/L), not a Schedule 4 limit

decisions.title: ECCC Federal Water Quality Guideline for copper - biotic ligand model, dissolved copper
decisions.decision: Guideline expressed as dissolved Cu via BLM, not total
decisions.relevance: Receiving-water objectives for copper should be derived on the dissolved basis; a total-copper target is a conservatism layer

gaps.affects: Water treatment duration and effluent targets (T1, R2, F3)
